description: This file defines a React functional component called Navbar that renders the application's navigation bar. It includes links for dashboard, apply leave, my leaves, leave balance, and admin-specific links, along with sign-in and sign-out controls. It manages authentication state, user roles, and feature flags for logout behavior.

methods.name: Navbar()
methods.description: Main functional React component rendering the navigation bar, handling user authentication status, role-based link rendering, and feature-flag-controlled logout behavior.

methods.name: handleLogout
methods.description: Handles the sign-out process, respecting the feature flag for logout enablement, and managing error states during sign out.
